name: Suicide And Going To Heaven
overview: Scripture clearly affirms the sanctity of life, commanding 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13) and warning against foolishly ending life before its appointed time (Ecclesiastes 7:17). Jesus assures believers of abundant life through Him (John 10:10) and offers peace amid trials (John 16:33), promising salvation to all who call on His name (Romans 10:13). The example of the thief on the cross receiving assurance of paradise (Luke 23:43) underscores that eternal life is granted through faith in Christ, not by the manner of death.
